sentences.zh: 志第七禮儀七

translations.literal: Treatise 7: Rites 7
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Seven: Rites Seven

sentences.zh: ，太宗因修禮官奏事之次，言及喪服，太宗曰：「」於是侍中魏徵、禮部侍郎令狐德棻等奏議曰：

translations.literal: , when Taizong, during an occasion when rites officials were presenting business, spoke of mourning dress, Taizong said: "The passage concluded." Thereupon Palace Attendant Wei Zheng, Vice Minister of Rites Linghu Defen, and others submitted a deliberation, saying:
translations.idiomatic: While Taizong was hearing the rites officers on routine business, he turned to mourning dress. The emperor spoke; the passage concluded. Then Palace Attendant Wei Zheng, Vice Minister of Rites Linghu Defen, and others submitted a memorial:

sentences.zh: 制可之。

translations.literal: The ordinance approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 九月，修禮官長孫無忌等又奏曰：「依古喪服，甥為舅緦麻，舅報甥亦同此制。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, rites-revising officials Zhangsun Wuji and others again memorialized, saying: "According to ancient mourning dress, a nephew for his mother's brother wears three months' finest hemp; the mother's brother's return mourning for the nephew follows the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Zhangsun Wuji and the rites revision staff wrote that under the old mourning code a nephew wore three months' finest hemp for his mother's brother, and the uncle reciprocated the same.

sentences.zh: 貞觀年中，八座議奏：『舅服同姨，小功五月。

translations.literal: In the Zhenguan era the Eight Seats deliberated and memorialized: 'For the mother's brother, mourning is the same as for the mother's sister—five months' lesser accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenguan the Eight Seats had ruled that mourning for a mother's brother matched that for a mother's sister: five months' lesser accomplishment.

sentences.zh: 』而今律疏，舅報於甥，服猶三月。

translations.literal: ' Yet in the present Code and Commentaries, the mother's brother's return mourning toward the nephew is still three months.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the current Code and Commentaries still fixed the uncle's return mourning for a nephew at three months.

sentences.zh: 謹按旁尊之服，禮無不報，已非正尊，不敢降也。

translations.literal: We respectfully note that for mourning toward collateral elders, ritual never lacks return mourning; though they are not primary elders, one dare not reduce it.
translations.idiomatic: Collateral elders always received return mourning in ritual; though not primary kin, the grade must not be cut.

sentences.zh: 故甥為從母五月，從母報甥小功，甥為舅緦麻，舅亦報甥三月，是其義矣。

translations.literal: Thus a nephew for the mother's sister wears five months; the mother's sister's return for the nephew is lesser accomplishment; a nephew for the mother's brother wears finest hemp; the mother's brother also returns finest hemp for the nephew three months—that is the principle.
translations.idiomatic: So a nephew wore five months for a mother's sister, and she returned lesser accomplishment; for a mother's brother he wore finest hemp, and the uncle returned three months' finest hemp—that was the pattern.

sentences.zh: 今甥為舅使同從母之喪，則舅宜進甥以同從母之報。

translations.literal: Now if a nephew for his mother's brother is made the same as mourning for the mother's sister, then the mother's brother ought to advance his return for the nephew to match the mother's sister's return.
translations.idiomatic: If a nephew's mourning for his mother's brother was raised to match a mother's sister, the uncle's return mourning for the nephew should rise to match her return as well.

sentences.zh: 修律疏人不知禮意，舅報甥服，尚止緦麻，於例不通，禮須改正。

translations.literal: Those who revised the Code and Commentaries did not know ritual intent; the mother's brother's return mourning for the nephew still stopping at finest hemp is inconsistent with precedent and ritual must be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: The Code revisers had missed the point: leaving the uncle's return at finest hemp broke precedent and had to be fixed.

sentences.zh: 今請修改律疏，舅報甥亦功。

translations.literal: We now request revision of the Code and Commentaries so that the mother's brother's return mourning for the nephew is also lesser accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that the Code be amended so the uncle's return mourning for a nephew was also lesser accomplishment.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「庶母古禮緦麻，新禮無服。

translations.literal: " They also said: "In ancient ritual a secondary mother was finest hemp; in the new ritual there is no mourning.
translations.idiomatic: They added: ancient ritual required finest hemp for a secondary mother; the new code required none.

sentences.zh: 謹按庶母之子，即是己昆季，為之杖期，而己與之無服。

translations.literal: We respectfully note that sons of a secondary mother are one's own brothers and sisters; for them one wears staff for one year, yet for the secondary mother oneself wears none.
translations.idiomatic: Sons of a secondary mother were full siblings: one wore staff for a year for them, yet wore nothing for the secondary mother herself.

sentences.zh: 同氣之內，吉凶頓殊，求之禮情，深非至理。

translations.literal: Within the same breath, fortune and misfortune suddenly differ—sought in ritual feeling, this is deeply not ultimate reason.
translations.idiomatic: Within one flesh, joy and grief were graded worlds apart—a poor fit to ritual feeling.

sentences.zh: 請依典故，為服緦麻。

translations.literal: We request that according to ancient precedent mourning of finest hemp be worn.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that precedent be restored: finest hemp for a secondary mother.

sentences.zh: 」制又從之。

translations.literal: " The ordinance again approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved again.

sentences.zh: 八月，所司奏：「司文正卿蕭嗣業，嫡繼母改嫁身亡，請申心制。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the relevant office memorialized: "Director of Literary Affairs Xiao Siye's legitimate stepmother remarried and died; he requests to declare heart mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: the relevant office reported that Xiao Siye, Director of Literary Affairs, sought heart mourning after his legitimate stepmother remarried and died.

sentences.zh: 據令，繼母改嫁及為長子，並不解官。

translations.literal: According to the ordinance, a stepmother's remarriage and being the eldest son both do not require leaving office.
translations.idiomatic: The code said neither a stepmother's remarriage nor being eldest son required leaving office.

sentences.zh: 」既而有敕：「」司禮太常伯隴西郡王博乂等奏稱：

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict: "The passage concluded." Director of Ceremonies and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Bo Yi, Prince of Longxi Commandery, and others memorialized, stating:
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed; the passage concluded. Director of Ceremonies Bo Yi, Prince of Longxi, and others wrote:

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: The decree approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court assented.

sentences.zh: ，天后上表曰：「至如父在為母服止一期，雖心喪三年，服由尊降。

translations.literal: , Empress Wu submitted a memorial, saying: "As for when the father is alive, mourning for the mother stops at one cycle—though heart mourning is three years, the garment is reduced by reverence for the father.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu then memorialized: when the father still lived, mourning for the mother ended after one cycle; though heart mourning ran three years, the garment was cut by reverence for the father.

sentences.zh: 竊謂子之於母，慈愛特深，非母不生，非母不育。

translations.literal: I venture to say that in a child's relation to the mother, affection is especially deep—without the mother one is not born, without the mother one is not reared.
translations.idiomatic: A child owes the mother a singular depth of love: without her there is no birth, without her no rearing.

sentences.zh: 推燥居濕，咽苦吐甘，生養勞瘁，恩斯極矣！

translations.literal: Tending dryness and wetness, swallowing bitterness and spitting sweetness—the toil of bearing and rearing, kindness reaches its utmost!
translations.idiomatic: She tended his dryness and wetness, swallowed bitterness and gave sweetness—the labor of nurture exhausts what kindness can mean.

sentences.zh: 所以禽獸之情，猶知其母，三年在懷，理宜崇報。

translations.literal: Therefore even beasts in feeling know their mother; three years in the womb—by principle one ought to honor her in return.
translations.idiomatic: Even beasts know their dam; three years in the womb demand a commensurate return.

sentences.zh: 若父在為母服止一期，尊父之敬雖周，報母之慈有闕。

translations.literal: If when the father is alive mourning for the mother stops at one cycle, reverence for the father is complete yet requital of the mother's kindness is lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Stopping at one cycle while the father lived honored him fully but left the mother's kindness short.

sentences.zh: 且齊斬之制，足為差減，更令周以一期，恐傷人子之志。

translations.literal: Moreover the hemmed-and-cut garment system is sufficient for graduated reduction; to make one cycle suffice where three years should apply would wound the son's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Hemmed sackcloth already graded the mourning; shrinking three years to one cycle would wound a son's intent.

sentences.zh: 今請父在為母終三年之服。

translations.literal: We now request that when the father is alive mourning for the mother run the full three years.
translations.idiomatic: She asked that when the father lived, mourning for the mother run the full three years.

sentences.zh: 」高宗下詔，依議行焉。

translations.literal: " Gaozong issued a decree and followed the proposal in practice.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong decreed and put her proposal into practice.

sentences.zh: ，右補闕盧履冰上言：「准禮，父在為母一週除靈，三年心喪。

translations.literal: , Right Remonstrator Lu Lübing submitted a memorial: "According to ritual, when the father is alive, for the mother one cycle until removal of the spirit tablet, three years' heart mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrator Lu Lübing wrote: ritual fixed one cycle until tablet removal and three years' heart mourning for a mother while the father lived.

sentences.zh: 則天皇后請同父沒之服，三年然始除靈。

translations.literal: Empress Wu Zetian requested mourning the same as when the father is dead—three years before removal of the spirit tablet.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu had asked for the same garment as when the father was dead—three years before tablet removal.

sentences.zh: 雖則權行，有紊彝典。

translations.literal: Though it was provisionally carried out, it disorderly violated the constant canon.
translations.idiomatic: That expedient had been carried out, but it tangled the standing canon.

sentences.zh: 今陛下孝理天下，動合禮經，請仍舊章，庶葉通典。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty filially governs the realm and moves in accord with ritual classics; we request return to the old articles, that it may accord with the comprehensive canon.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor now governed by filial piety and ritual; Lübing asked to restore the old rule and align with the comprehensive canon.

sentences.zh: 」於是下制令百官詳議；

translations.literal: " Thereupon a decree was issued ordering the hundred officials to deliberate in detail;
translations.idiomatic: A decree ordered the bureaucracy to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 並舅及嫂叔服不依舊禮，亦合議定。

translations.literal: mourning for mother's brothers and sisters-in-law and younger uncles not following the old ritual should also be settled by deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning for uncles, aunts, sisters-in-law, and younger uncles that no longer matched the old ritual was to be settled in the same review.

sentences.zh: 刑部郎中田再思建議曰：

translations.literal: Penal Bureau Director Tian Zaosi proposed:
translations.idiomatic: Penal Bureau Director Tian Zaosi offered a proposal.

sentences.zh: 於是紛議不定。

translations.literal: Thereupon debate was unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Debate deadlocked.

sentences.zh: 履冰又上疏曰：「《禮》：父在，為母十一月而練，十三月而祥，十五月而禫，心喪三年。

translations.literal: Lübing again submitted a memorial, saying: "The Ritual: when the father is alive, for the mother eleven months then practice; thirteenth month auspicious; fifteenth month end-of-mourning; heart mourning three years.
translations.idiomatic: Lübing wrote again, citing the Ritual: while the father lived, for the mother eleven months to practice, thirteenth month auspicious rites, fifteenth month end-of-mourning, and three years' heart mourning.

sentences.zh: 上元中，則天皇后上表，請同父沒之服，亦未有行。

translations.literal: In the Shangyuan era Empress Wu Zetian submitted a memorial requesting mourning the same as when the father is dead, yet it was still not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In Shangyuan Wu had asked for mourning equal to a father's death, but it had not yet taken effect.

sentences.zh: 至垂拱年中，始編入格，易代之後，俗乃通行。

translations.literal: By the Chuigong era it was first entered into the administrative code; after the change of dynasty the custom then spread in practice.
translations.idiomatic: Only in Chuigong was it written into the code; after the dynastic shift the custom spread.

sentences.zh: 臣，頻請仍舊。

translations.literal: Your servant, repeatedly requesting return to the old rule.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant had repeatedly asked to restore the old rule.

sentences.zh: 恩敕並嫂叔舅姨之服，亦付所司詳議。

translations.literal: The gracious edict also entrusted mourning for sisters-in-law, younger uncles, and mother's brothers and sisters to the relevant offices for detailed deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The throne also sent mourning for sisters-in-law, younger uncles, and maternal kin to the relevant offices for review.

sentences.zh: 諸司所議，同異相參。

translations.literal: The offices' deliberations mixed agreement and difference.
translations.idiomatic: The offices split.

sentences.zh: 所司惟執齊斬之文，又曰亦合典禮。

translations.literal: The relevant office alone held to the text on hemmed and cut garments, and also said it accorded with canonical ritual.
translations.idiomatic: One office clung to the hemmed-sackcloth articles and called that canonical.

sentences.zh: 竊見新修之格，猶依垂拱之偽，致有祖父母安存，子孫之妻亡沒，下房筵幾，亦立再周，甚無謂也。

translations.literal: I observe that the newly revised code still follows the Chuigong error, so that when grandparents are alive and a grandson's wife dies, in the lower apartments a second full cycle is also observed—most meaningless.
translations.idiomatic: The new code still followed Chuigong's error: with grandparents alive and a grandson's wife dead, lower apartments sometimes observed a second full cycle—absurd.

sentences.zh: 據《周易·家人》卦云：『利女貞女正位於內，男正位於外。

translations.literal: According to the Changes, Family hexagram: 'It profits the woman's constancy; the woman holds correct position within, the man holds correct position without.
translations.idiomatic: The Changes, Family hexagram, says: constancy profits the woman; she holds correct position within, the man without.

sentences.zh: 男女正，天地之大義。

translations.literal: Man and woman correct—this is the great principle of Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Correct man and woman embody Heaven and Earth's great principle.

sentences.zh: 家人有嚴君焉，父母之謂也。

translations.literal: The family has a stern lord—this means father and mother.
translations.idiomatic: A household has a stern lord: father and mother.

sentences.zh: 父父、子子、兄兄、弟弟、夫夫、婦婦，家道正而天下正矣。

translations.literal: Father as father, son as son, elder brother as elder brother, younger brother as younger brother, husband as husband, wife as wife—the family way is correct and the realm is correct.
translations.idiomatic: Father father, son son, elder brother elder brother, younger brother younger brother, husband husband, wife wife—right the family and the realm follows.

sentences.zh: 』《禮》：『女在室，以父為天；

translations.literal: ' The Ritual: 'A woman in the chamber takes the father as Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual says: in the chamber a woman takes her father as Heaven;

sentences.zh: 出嫁，以夫為天。

translations.literal: after marriage, she takes the husband as Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: after marriage she takes her husband as Heaven.

sentences.zh: 』又：『在家從父，出嫁從夫，夫死從子。

translations.literal: ' Again: 'At home she follows the father; after marriage she follows the husband; when the husband dies she follows the son.
translations.idiomatic: Again: at home she follows the father, in marriage the husband, in widowhood the son.

sentences.zh: 』本無自專抗尊之法。

translations.literal: ' Fundamentally there is no law of self-willed defiance of elders.
translations.idiomatic: There is no charter for defying elders on one's own.

sentences.zh: 即《喪服四制》云：『天無二日，土無二王，國無二君，家無二尊，以一理之也。

translations.literal: The Mourning Dress Four Principles says: 'Heaven has no two suns, earth no two kings, the state no two lords, the family no two elders—one principle governs.
translations.idiomatic: The Mourning Dress Four Principles says: Heaven has no two suns, earth no two kings, a state no two lords, a family no two elders—one principle rules all.

sentences.zh: 故父在為母服周者，避二尊也。

translations.literal: Therefore when the father is alive mourning for the mother is one cycle—to avoid two elders.
translations.idiomatic: Hence while the father lives, mourning for the mother is one cycle—to avoid two elders in one house.

sentences.zh: 』伏惟陛下正持家國，孝理天下，而不斷在宸衷，詳正此禮，無隨末俗，顧念兒女之情。

translations.literal: ' I bow and consider that Your Majesty rightly holds family and state and filially governs the realm, yet does not decide in the imperial heart and correct this ritual in detail—do not follow vulgar custom and indulge children's feelings.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty rightly orders family and state by filial rule, yet has not settled this rite in the imperial heart—do not follow custom and indulge a child's feeling alone.

sentences.zh: 臣恐後代復有婦奪夫政之敗者。

translations.literal: Your servant fears that later ages will again have women who usurp their husbands' government.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant fears later ages will again see wives seize their husbands' authority.

translations.literal: The memorial concluded."
translations.idiomatic: The memorial closed.

sentences.zh: 疏奏未報。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted and not answered.
translations.idiomatic: No answer came.

sentences.zh: 履冰又上奏曰：

translations.literal: Lübing again submitted a memorial:
translations.idiomatic: Lübing wrote again.

sentences.zh: 左散騎常侍元行沖奏議曰：「天地之性，惟人最靈者，蓋以智周萬物，惟睿作聖，明貴賤，辨尊卑，遠嫌疑，分情理也。

translations.literal: Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Yuan Xingchong submitted a deliberation, saying: "Of Heaven and Earth's nature, only the human is most spiritual—because wisdom encompasses the ten thousand things, only the perspicacious become sage, discerning noble and base, distinguishing honored and humble, keeping distant what is suspect, dividing feeling and principle.
translations.idiomatic: Left Cavalry Regular Attendant Yuan Xingchong argued: among Heaven and Earth's creatures only humans are most spirit-filled—wisdom spans the ten thousand things, the perspicacious become sages, they sort noble and base, honored and humble, keep distance from suspicion, and divide feeling from principle.

sentences.zh: 是以古之聖人，征性識本，緣情制服，有申有厭。

translations.literal: Therefore the ancient sages examined nature to know the root, followed feeling to set garments—there is extension and there is reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient sages read nature for the root and followed feeling to set garments—sometimes extending, sometimes reducing.

sentences.zh: 天父、天夫，故斬衰三年，情理俱盡者，因心立極也。

translations.literal: Heaven as father, Heaven as husband—therefore full sackcloth three years; where feeling and principle are both exhausted, the heart establishes the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven is father, Heaven is husband—hence three years' full sackcloth where feeling and principle are both spent, the heart sets the utmost limit.

sentences.zh: 生則齊體，死則同穴，比陰陽而配合，同兩儀而成化。

translations.literal: In life they share one body; in death one grave—matching yin and yang in union, forming transformation with the two principles.
translations.idiomatic: Alive they share one body; dead one grave—yin and yang paired, the two principles made whole.

sentences.zh: 而妻喪杖期，情禮俱殺者，蓋以遠嫌疑，尊乾道也。

translations.literal: Yet for a wife's mourning, staff for one year—where feeling and ritual are both reduced—is because one keeps distant what is suspect and honors the yang way.
translations.idiomatic: Yet a wife's death brings staff for one year—feeling and ritual both cut—to keep distance from suspicion and honor the yang way.

sentences.zh: 父為嫡子三年斬衰，而不去職者，蓋尊祖重嫡，崇禮殺情也。

translations.literal: A father for the legitimate son wears three years' full sackcloth yet does not leave office—because one honors the grandfather and values the legitimate line, exalting ritual and reducing feeling.
translations.idiomatic: A father wears three years' full sackcloth for a legitimate son yet does not leave office—honoring the grandfather, weighting the legitimate line, exalting ritual over feeling.

sentences.zh: 資於事父以事君，孝莫大於嚴父。

translations.literal: Taking service to the father as service to the lord—no filial piety is greater than honoring the father.
translations.idiomatic: Serving the lord as one serves the father—no filial piety exceeds honoring the father.

sentences.zh: 故父在，為母罷職齊周而心喪三年，謂之尊厭者，則情申而禮殺也。

translations.literal: Therefore when the father is alive, for the mother one leaves office for hemmed sackcloth one cycle and heart mourning three years—called honored reduction: feeling is extended but ritual is reduced.
translations.idiomatic: So while the father lives, for the mother one leaves office, wears hemmed sackcloth one cycle, and heart-mourns three years—honored reduction: feeling extended, ritual cut.

sentences.zh: 斯制也，可以異於飛走，別於華夷。

translations.literal: This system can distinguish one from birds and beasts and set one apart from the civilized and the barbarian.
translations.idiomatic: That system separates humans from beasts and the civilized from the barbarian.

sentences.zh: 羲、農、堯、舜，莫之易也；

translations.literal: Xi, Nong, Yao, and Shun—none altered it;
translations.idiomatic: Xi, Nong, Yao, and Shun never altered it;

sentences.zh: 文、武、周、孔，同所尊也。

translations.literal: Wen, Wu, Zhou, and Confucius honored it alike.
translations.idiomatic: Wen, Wu, the Zhou, and Confucius honored it alike.

sentences.zh: 今若舍尊厭之重，虧嚴父之義，略純素之嫌，貽非聖之責，則事不師古，有傷名教矣。

translations.literal: If now one abandons the weight of honored reduction, injures the principle of honoring the father, overlooks the suspicion of plain white garments, and invites the blame of being un-sage-like, then affairs do not take the ancients as teachers and name-teaching is wounded.
translations.idiomatic: To cast off honored reduction, wound reverence for the father, ignore the suspicion plain garments guard against, and invite the charge of defying the sages would abandon the ancients and harm moral teaching.

sentences.zh: 姨兼從母之名，即母之女黨，加於舅服，有理存焉。

translations.literal: The mother's sister shares the name of the mother's sister—she is the mother's female kindred; increasing mourning for the mother's brother has reason in it.
translations.idiomatic: A mother's sister shares the mother's sister's name—she is the mother's female line; raising mourning for a mother's brother has its reason.

sentences.zh: 嫂叔不服，避嫌疑也。

translations.literal: Sister-in-law and younger uncle do not wear mourning—to avoid suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: Sisters-in-law and younger uncles wore no mourning—to avoid suspicion.

sentences.zh: 若引同爨之緦，以忘推遠之跡，既乖前聖，亦謂難從。

translations.literal: If one cites finest hemp for sharing the hearth and forgets the trace of pushing distant, it both departs from former sages and is hard to follow.
translations.idiomatic: To cite finest hemp for sharing a hearth and forget the rule of pushing kin distant both departs from the sages and is hard to follow.

sentences.zh: 謹詳三者之疑，並請依古為當。

translations.literal: We respectfully examine the doubts in all three cases and together request that following the ancient is correct.
translations.idiomatic: On all three doubtful points he asked that the ancient rule stand.

sentences.zh: 」自是百僚議意不決。

translations.literal: " From this the hundred officials' deliberations did not decide.
translations.idiomatic: The bureaucracy still could not settle.

sentences.zh: 至七年八月，下敕曰：「」自是卿士之家，父在為母行服不同：或既周而禫，禫服六十日釋服，心喪三年者；

translations.literal: By the eighth month of the seventh year a decree: "The passage concluded." From this in the homes of ministers and grandees, mourning for the mother while the father lived differed: some, having completed one cycle and end-of-mourning, wore end-of-mourning garments sixty days then left garments, with heart mourning three years;
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, eighth month: a decree; the passage concluded. Thereafter ministerial households diverged: some finished one cycle and end-of-mourning, wore end-of-mourning dress sixty days, then left garments while heart-mourning three years;

sentences.zh: 或有既周而禫服終三年者；

translations.literal: some, having completed one cycle, wore end-of-mourning garments for the full three years;
translations.idiomatic: some kept end-of-mourning dress the full three years after one cycle;

sentences.zh: 或有依上元之制，齊衰三年者。

translations.literal: some followed the Shangyuan system of hemmed sackcloth three years.
translations.idiomatic: some followed Shangyuan's hemmed sackcloth for three years.

sentences.zh: 時議者是非紛然，元行沖謂人曰：「聖人制厭降之禮，豈不知母恩之深也，以尊祖貴祢，欲其遠別禽獸，近異夷狄故也。

translations.literal: Debaters of the time right and wrong were clamorous; Yuan Xingchong said to people: "The sage instituted the ritual of honored reduction—how could he not know the depth of a mother's kindness? It is because one honors the grandfather and values the temple founder, wishing people to keep far from beasts and near yet distinct from barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Opinion swarmed; Yuan Xingchong told colleagues: the sage made honored reduction knowing a mother's kindness full well—he honored the grandfather and the temple founder so people would stand far from beasts and near yet apart from barbarians.

sentences.zh: 人情易搖，淺識者眾。

translations.literal: Human feeling is easy to sway; those of shallow understanding are many.
translations.idiomatic: Feeling sways easily; shallow views are common.

sentences.zh: 一紊其度，其可止乎！

translations.literal: Once the measure is disorderly, how can it be stopped!
translations.idiomatic: Once the measure tangles, who can stop it?

sentences.zh: 」二十年，中書令蕭嵩與學士改修定五禮，又議請依上元敕，父在為母齊衰三年為定。

translations.literal: " In the twentieth year, Secretariat Director Xiao Song and academicians again revised and fixed the Five Rites, and again deliberated requesting that according to the Shangyuan decree, when the father is alive hemmed sackcloth three years for the mother be made fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Year twenty: Secretariat Director Xiao Song and the academicians revised the Five Rites and again asked to fix Shangyuan's rule—hemmed sackcloth three years for a mother while the father lived.

sentences.zh: 及頒禮，乃一依行焉。

translations.literal: When the rites were promulgated, all followed it in practice.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were issued, everyone followed them.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，藉田禮畢，正制曰：「」太常卿韋縚奏曰：「謹按《儀禮喪服》：舅，緦麻三月。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, after the plowing rite was completed, a formal ordinance said: "The passage concluded." Director of Ceremonies Wei Yun memorialized, saying: "We respectfully note the Ceremonial Ritual Mourning Dress: mother's brother, three months' finest hemp.
translations.idiomatic: Year twenty-three, after the plowing rite: a formal ordinance; the passage concluded. Director of Ceremonies Wei Yun wrote, citing the Ceremonial Mourning Dress: a mother's brother, three months' finest hemp.

sentences.zh: 從母，小功五月。

translations.literal: Mother's sister, five months' lesser accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: A mother's sister, five months' lesser accomplishment.

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：可以小功，以名加也。

translations.literal: The Commentary says: one may use lesser accomplishment—added by the name.
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary: lesser accomplishment may apply—the name adds the grade.

sentences.zh: 堂姨舅、舅母，恩所不及。

translations.literal: Hall mother's brothers and sisters, mother's brothers' wives—kindness does not reach.
translations.idiomatic: Hall cousins on the mother's side and uncles' wives—kindness does not reach them.

sentences.zh: 外祖父母。

translations.literal: Maternal grandparents.
translations.idiomatic: Maternal grandparents—

sentences.zh: 小功五月。

translations.literal: five months' lesser accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: five months of lesser accomplishment mourning.

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：何以小功，以尊加也。

translations.literal: The Commentary says: why lesser accomplishment? Added by the honored status.
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary asks why lesser accomplishment: honor raises the grade.

sentences.zh: 舅，緦麻三月，並是情親而服屬疏者也。

translations.literal: Mother's brother, three months' finest hemp—all are close in feeling yet distant in garment kinship.
translations.idiomatic: A mother's brother, three months' finest hemp—all close in feeling, distant in kin grade.

sentences.zh: 外祖正尊，同於從母之服。

translations.literal: Maternal grandparents are primary elders, the same as mourning for the mother's sister.
translations.idiomatic: Maternal grandparents are primary elders, the same grade as a mother's sister.

sentences.zh: 姨舅一等，服則輕重有殊。

translations.literal: Mother's sister and mother's brother are one class, yet garments differ in light and heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Mother's sister and mother's brother are one class, yet the garments differ in weight.

sentences.zh: 堂姨舅親即未疏，恩絕不相為服。

translations.literal: Hall mother's brothers and sisters—the kin is not yet distant, yet kindness is severed and they do not wear mourning for one another.
translations.idiomatic: Hall cousins are not yet distant kin, yet kindness is cut and they wear no mourning for each other.

sentences.zh: 親舅母來承外族，同爨之禮不加。

translations.literal: A mother's brother's wife who comes to join the outer clan—the ritual of sharing the hearth is not added.
translations.idiomatic: An uncle's wife who joins the outer clan does not receive the shared-hearth rite.

sentences.zh: 竊以古意猶有所未暢者也。

translations.literal: I venture that in ancient intent something is still not fully expressed.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient intent, he ventured, was not yet fully expressed.

sentences.zh: 且為外祖小功，此則正尊情甚親而服屬疏者也，請加至大功九月。

translations.literal: Moreover for maternal grandparents lesser accomplishment—this is primary elder, feeling very close yet garment kinship distant—we request increase to greater accomplishment nine months.
translations.idiomatic: Maternal grandparents wore lesser accomplishment though feeling was very close and kin grade distant—he asked to raise them to nine months' greater accomplishment.

sentences.zh: 姨舅儕類，親既無別，服宜齊等，請為舅加至小功五月。

translations.literal: Mother's sister and mother's brother are the same class; the kin is without distinction—the garment ought to be equal; we request for the mother's brother increase to five months' lesser accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: Mother's sister and mother's brother were the same class without kin distinction—the garment should match; he asked five months' lesser accomplishment for a mother's brother.

sentences.zh: 堂姨舅疏降一等，親舅母從服之例，先無制服之文，並望加至袒免。

translations.literal: Hall mother's brothers and sisters reduced one grade; a mother's brother's wife following-garment precedent—formerly no garment text existed—we together hope to add to baring shoulder and untying cap-band.
translations.idiomatic: Hall cousins dropped one grade; an uncle's wife had no prior garment rule—he asked baring shoulder and untying the cap-band for them all.

sentences.zh: 臣聞禮以飾情，服從義制，或有沿革，損益可明。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that rites adorn feeling and mourning garments follow righteous regulation; there may be continuations and changes, and what is to be reduced or increased can be made clear.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that ritual adorns emotion and mourning dress follows moral rule—where practice has shifted, what to add or trim can be stated plainly.

sentences.zh: 事體既大，理資詳審。

translations.literal: The matter in its substance is already great; reason requires thorough deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The matter is weighty and calls for careful deliberation.

sentences.zh: 望付尚書省集眾官吏詳議，務從折衷，永為典則。

translations.literal: We hope it may be entrusted to the Department of State Affairs to assemble the multitude of officials for detailed discussion, striving for compromise, and made a perpetual standard.
translations.idiomatic: Please refer it to the Department of State Affairs for a full council of officials, seek a balanced outcome, and fix it as a lasting rule.

translations.literal: The passage concluded."
translations.idiomatic: The quote ended.

sentences.zh: 於是太子賓客崔沔建議曰：「竊聞大道既隱，天下為家。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Mentor of the Heir Apparent Cui Mian submitted a recommendation, saying: "Your servant has heard that when the Great Way was concealed, all under Heaven became one's household.
translations.idiomatic: Then Mentor of the Heir Apparent Cui Mian memorialized: "I have heard that once the Great Way was hidden, the realm became a single household.

sentences.zh: 聖人因之，然後製禮。

translations.literal: The sages followed this and thereafter fashioned rites.
translations.idiomatic: The sages took that as their basis and then fashioned ritual.

sentences.zh: 禮教之設，本為正家，家道正而天下定矣。

translations.literal: The establishment of ritual teaching was fundamentally to rectify the family; when the family way is rectified, all under Heaven is settled.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual teaching was instituted chiefly to set the household in order; when the household is right, the realm is stable.

sentences.zh: 正家之道，不可以貳，總一定議，理歸本宗。

translations.literal: The way to rectify the family cannot be twofold; to gather and fix one deliberation, reason returns to the root lineage.
translations.idiomatic: The way to order a household cannot be divided in two: one settled rule, with principle anchored in the main line.

sentences.zh: 父以尊崇，母以厭降，豈忘愛敬，宜存倫序。

translations.literal: The father is honored and elevated; the mother is suppressed and demoted—how could one forget love and respect? One should preserve the order of human relations.
translations.idiomatic: The father is exalted and the mother reduced in rank—not to forget love and respect, but to keep relational order.

sentences.zh: 是以內有齊斬，外服皆緦麻，尊名所加，不過一等，此先王不易之道也。

translations.literal: Therefore within there is zhan and cui; for external relations all wear si hemp; where honored names are added, it does not exceed one grade—this is the unchanging way of the former kings.
translations.idiomatic: Hence within the family are the heaviest grades of mourning; for outside kin all wear the lightest hemp; added honor never exceeds one step—this is the former kings' unchanging rule.

sentences.zh: 前聖所志，後賢所傳，其來久矣。

translations.literal: What former sages recorded, later worthies transmitted—their coming has long been so.
translations.idiomatic: What the ancient sages set down and later worthies handed on has stood for ages.

sentences.zh: 昔辛有適伊川，見被髮而祭於野者，曰：『不及百年，此其戎乎？

translations.literal: In antiquity Xin You went to Yichuan and saw one with disheveled hair sacrificing in the wild, saying: 'Within less than a hundred years, will this be the Rong?
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Xin You went to Yichuan and saw people with loose hair sacrificing in the open country, and said, 'In less than a hundred years, will this be the Rong?

sentences.zh: 其禮先亡矣！

translations.literal: Their rites will perish first!'
translations.idiomatic: Their ritual will die first!'

sentences.zh: 』貞觀修禮，時改舊章，漸廣渭陽之恩，不遵洙、泗之典。

translations.literal: In Zhenguan's revision of rites the times altered the old statutes, gradually widening the affection of the Wei-yang ode and not following the canons of Zhu and Si.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenguan revised ritual, old statutes were altered, maternal kin were favored ever more widely, and the standards of Confucius's homeland were left aside.

sentences.zh: 及弘道之後，唐隆之間，國命再移於外族矣。

translations.literal: Reaching after Hongdao and in the Tanglong era, the nation's mandate twice shifted to alien clans.
translations.idiomatic: After Hongdao and in the Tanglong years, the dynastic mandate twice passed to outsiders.

sentences.zh: 禮亡徵兆，儻或斯見，天人之際，可不誡哉！

translations.literal: The perishing of rites had its omens—perhaps this is seen; at the juncture of Heaven and man, can one not be warned!
translations.idiomatic: The death of ritual had its omens—perhaps we see them here; at the meeting of Heaven and humanity, ought we not take warning!

sentences.zh: 開元初，補闕盧履冰嘗進狀論喪服輕重，敕令僉議。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyuan, Remonstrance Councillor Lu Lübing once submitted a memorial discussing the light and heavy grades of mourning garments; an edict ordered collective deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan, Remonstrance Councillor Lu Lübing had memorialized on the grades of mourning dress, and an edict ordered joint deliberation.

sentences.zh: 於時群議紛拏，各安積習，太常禮部，奏依舊定。

translations.literal: At that time the multitude of discussions were tangled; each clung to accumulated custom; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Ministry of Rites memorialized to follow the old fixings.
translations.idiomatic: Debate then was tangled, each side clinging to habit; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Ministry of Rites urged keeping the old rules.

sentences.zh: 陛下運稽古之思，發獨斷之明，至，特降別敕，一依古禮。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, exercising reflection on antiquity and issuing independent, clarifying judgments, by the eighth year of Kaiyuan specially promulgated a separate edict, wholly following the ancient rites.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, drawing on antiquity and acting with decisive clarity, in Kaiyuan 8 issued a special edict restoring the ancient mourning rules in full.

sentences.zh: 事符故實，人知向方，式固宗盟，社稷之福。

translations.literal: The matter accords with former facts; people know the direction; it firmly secures the clan bond—the fortune of the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: That matched ancient precedent, gave the people a clear standard, and strengthened the clan bond—a blessing to the state.

sentences.zh: 更圖異議，竊所未詳。

translations.literal: To plot further divergent discussion—your servant has not yet understood.
translations.idiomatic: To reopen dispute on this point is, in my view, hard to understand.

sentences.zh: 願守八年明旨，以為萬代成法。

translations.literal: We hope to preserve the clear directive of the eighth year as the enduring law for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the clear mandate of Kaiyuan 8 be kept as the permanent law for ages to come.
The quote ended.

sentences.zh: 職方郎中韋述議曰：

translations.literal: Director of Staff Registration Wei Shu submitted an opinion, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Director of Staff Registration Wei Shu offered this view:

sentences.zh: 禮部員外郎楊仲昌議曰：「謹按《儀禮》曰：『外服皆緦。

translations.literal: Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites Yang Zhongchang submitted an opinion, saying: "Your servant respectfully examines the Ceremonies, which says: 'External mourning garments are all si hemp.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of Rites Yang Zhongchang wrote: "I have reviewed the Ceremonies, which states, 'All mourning for external kin is si hemp.

sentences.zh: 』又曰：『外祖父母以尊加，從母以名加，並為小功五月。

translations.literal: ' It also says: 'Maternal grandparents, by addition of honor, and mother's sisters, by addition of name, are both xiao gong for five months.
translations.idiomatic: ' It also says, 'Maternal grandparents, by honor added, and mother's sisters, by name added, both wear xiao gong for five months.

sentences.zh: 』其為舅緦，鄭文貞公魏徵已議同從母例，加至小功五月訖。

translations.literal: ' For the mother's brother, si hemp—Duke of Zheng Wen, Wei Zheng, already deliberated to follow the mother's-sister precedent, increasing to xiao gong for five months, and that is settled.
translations.idiomatic: ' For the maternal uncle, si hemp—Wei Zheng, Duke of Zhengwen, had already argued he should match the mother's sister at xiao gong for five months, and that was settled.

sentences.zh: 今之所加，豈異前旨？

translations.literal: What is now to be added—how does it differ from the former intent?
translations.idiomatic: What is now proposed to be added—how does it differ from that earlier ruling?

sentences.zh: 雖文貞賢也，而周、孔聖也，以賢改聖，後學何從？

translations.literal: Though Wen was worthy, yet Zhou and Confucius were sages; to use the worthy to alter the sage—what are later students to follow?
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zheng was worthy, but Zhou and Confucius were sages; to let worthies revise sages—what should later students follow?

sentences.zh: 堂舅姨、堂舅母，並升為袒免，則何以祖述禮經乎？

translations.literal: Hall mother's brothers and sisters and hall mother's brothers' wives, all raised to tan mian—then how may one trace and transmit the ritual classics?
translations.idiomatic: Cousins on the mother's side and their wives, all raised to tan mian—how then can we claim to follow the ritual canon?

sentences.zh: 如以外祖父母加至大功，則豈無加報於外孫乎？

translations.literal: If for maternal grandparents one increases to da gong, then would there not also be added return mourning for maternal grandsons?
translations.idiomatic: If maternal grandparents are raised to da gong, must not maternal grandsons also return the heavier mourning?

sentences.zh: 如外孫為報，服大功，則本宗庶孫，何同等而相淺乎？

translations.literal: If maternal grandsons in return wore da gong, then the common grandsons of the root lineage—why are they equal in rank yet shallower in mourning?
translations.idiomatic: If maternal grandsons wore da gong in return, how could patrilineal grandsons of the same degree wear less?

sentences.zh: 儻必如是，深所不便。

translations.literal: If it must be so, this is deeply inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: If it must be so, the inconvenience is grave.

sentences.zh: 竊恐內外乖序，親疏奪倫、情之所沿，何所不至，理必然也。

translations.literal: Your servant fears inner and outer will lose their order, near and distant will usurp rank, and where feeling leads—what will not follow? Reason demands it.
translations.idiomatic: I fear inner and outer kin will fall out of order and near and far will invert rank—where feeling leads, what limit will hold? That is inevitable.

sentences.zh: 昔子路有姊之喪而不除，孔子問之，子路對曰：『吾寡兄弟而不忍也。

translations.literal: In antiquity Zilu had mourning for a sister yet did not remove the garments; Confucius questioned him, and Zilu replied: 'I have few brothers and sisters and cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Zilu mourned a sister but would not leave off the garments; Confucius asked him, and Zilu said, 'I have few siblings and cannot bear to do so.

sentences.zh: 』子曰：『先王制禮，行道之人皆不忍也。

translations.literal: ' The Master said: 'When the former kings fashioned rites, even travelers on the road could not bear it.
translations.idiomatic: ' The Master said, 'When the former kings made ritual, even passers-by felt the same reluctance.

sentences.zh: 』子路聞而除之。

translations.literal: ' Zilu heard this and removed the garments.
translations.idiomatic: ' Zilu heard and removed the mourning.

sentences.zh: 此則聖人因言以立訓，援事抑情之明例也。

translations.literal: This is the sage using words to establish instruction—an illuminating example of citing a case to restrain feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Here the sage turned a remark into teaching—an explicit case of using precedent to curb excess of feeling.

sentences.zh: 禮不云乎，無輕議禮。

translations.literal: Does ritual not say: do not lightly discuss ritual?
translations.idiomatic: Does ritual not say, Do not lightly debate ritual?

sentences.zh: 明共蟠於天地，並彼日月，賢者由之，安敢小有損益也！

translations.literal: Brightness coiled with Heaven and Earth, equal to sun and moon—the worthy follow it; how dare one make small additions or subtractions!
translations.idiomatic: It coils with Heaven and Earth and stands with sun and moon—the worthy follow it; who would dare trim it even slightly!

sentences.zh: 況夫《喪服》之紀，先王大猷，奉以周旋，以匡人道。

translations.literal: How much more the records of Mourning Garments—the great design of the former kings, upheld in practice to rectify the human way.
translations.idiomatic: Above all the Mourning Garments—the former kings' great design, carried in practice to set the human way right.

sentences.zh: 一辭寧措，千載是遵，涉於異端，豈曰弘教。

translations.literal: One word is better left unchanged; for a thousand years it is followed; to touch heterodox paths—how may one call that broadening teaching?
translations.idiomatic: A single phrase is not lightly altered; a thousand years follow it; to wander into side paths is not to enlarge teaching.

sentences.zh: 伏望各依正禮，以厚儒風。

translations.literal: We prostrate ourselves and hope each will follow the correct rites to thicken Confucian custom.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that all adhere to the orthodox rites and strengthen Confucian practice.

sentences.zh: 太常所謂增加，愚見以為不可。

translations.literal: What the Court of Imperial Sacrifices calls increase—in this foolish view cannot be approved.
translations.idiomatic: The increases urged by the Court of Imperial Sacrifices seem to me inadmissible.

sentences.zh: 」又戶部郎中楊伯成、左監門錄事參軍劉秩並同是議，與沔等略同。

translations.literal: " Also Bureau Director in the Ministry of Revenue Yang Bocheng and Left Gate Recorder Liu Zhi all submitted the same opinion, broadly matching Mian and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The quote ended. Bureau Director Yang Bocheng in the Ministry of Revenue and Left Gate Recorder Liu Zhi also wrote in the same vein, broadly agreeing with Cui Mian and his allies.

sentences.zh: 議奏，上又手敕侍臣等曰：「」

translations.literal: When the deliberations were memorialized, the emperor again personally edicted the attendant ministers, saying: "
translations.idiomatic: When the opinions were submitted, the emperor again personally instructed the chief ministers:

sentences.zh: 侍中裴耀卿、中書令張九齡、禮部尚書李林甫等奏曰：「外族之親，禮無厭降。

translations.literal: Attendant-in-chief Pei Yaoqing, Grand Counselor Zhang Jiuling, Minister of Rites Li Linfu, and others memorialized, saying: "Kin of the external clan—in ritual there is no suppressed demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Attendant Pei Yaoqing, Grand Counselor Zhang Jiuling, Minister of Rites Li Linfu, and others wrote: "External kin are not subject to ritual demotion.

sentences.zh: 外甥既為舅母制服，舅母還合報之。

translations.literal: The sister's son already wears mourning for the mother's brother's wife; the mother's brother's wife in turn ought to return it.
translations.idiomatic: A nephew already mourns his aunt by marriage; she in turn should return the obligation.

sentences.zh: 夫外甥既為報服，則與夫之姨舅，以類是同，外甥之妻，不得無服。

translations.literal: Since the sister's son already wears return mourning, then with the husband's mother's brothers and sisters it is the same by category; the sister's son's wife cannot be without mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If a nephew wears return mourning, the same logic covers the husband's aunts and uncles; a nephew's wife cannot go without dress.

sentences.zh: 所增者頗廣，所引者漸疏。

translations.literal: What is added is rather broad; what is cited grows ever more distant.
translations.idiomatic: What is added grows wide; what is cited grows remote.

sentences.zh: 微臣愚蒙，猶有未達。

translations.literal: This petty official, foolish and ignorant, still has what is not yet understood.
translations.idiomatic: We, dull and ignorant, still do not fully grasp it.

sentences.zh: 」玄宗又手製答曰：「」耀卿等奏曰：「陛下體至仁之德，廣推恩之道，將弘引進，以示睦親，再發德音，更令詳議。

translations.literal: " Emperor Xuanzong again personally composed a reply, saying: "" Yaoqing and others memorialized, saying: "Your Majesty embodies utmost benevolent virtue and broadly extends the way of grace, intending to enlarge kinship and display cordial kin relations, again issuing virtuous words and further ordering detailed deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The quote ended. Xuanzong also drafted a personal reply. Yaoqing and others then wrote: "Your Majesty embodies utmost benevolence and extends grace broadly, seeking to widen kinship and show familial warmth, and has again ordered further deliberation.

sentences.zh: 臣等按《大唐新禮》：親舅加至小功，與從母同服。

translations.literal: Your servants examine the New Tang Rites: the mother's brother increased to xiao gong, the same mourning as the mother's sister.
translations.idiomatic: We have reviewed the New Tang Rites: a mother's brother was raised to xiao gong, matching the mother's sister.

sentences.zh: 此蓋當時特命，不以輕重遞增，蓋不欲參於本宗，慎於變禮者也。

translations.literal: This was at that time a special command, not increasing grade by grade, broadly not wishing to mix with the root lineage—caution in altering ritual.
translations.idiomatic: That was a special order of the time, not a ladder of ever-heavier grades—chiefly to keep external kin from merging with the main line, a cautious change of ritual.

sentences.zh: 今聖制親姨舅小功，更制舅母緦麻，堂姨舅袒免等服，取類《新禮》，垂示將來，通於物情，自我作則。

translations.literal: Now the sage regulation makes mother's brothers and sisters xiao gong, further regulating the mother's brother's wife as si hemp, hall mother's brothers and sisters as tan mian, and the like—taking categories from the New Rites, displaying them for the future, penetrating common feeling, making the rule oneself.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty sets mother's brothers and sisters at xiao gong, an aunt by marriage at si hemp, and cousins on the mother's side at tan mian—following the New Rites as a type, showing the future a rule that fits human feeling and is made here and now.

sentences.zh: 群儒風議，徒有稽留。

translations.literal: The multitude of Confucians in discussion merely had delay.
translations.idiomatic: The Confucian debaters had only delayed.

sentences.zh: 並望准制施行。
